page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.8xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. The instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 128.0 GB of memory, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM balance with 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes 20 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and operates without attached local storage or bundled GPU acceleration.

Engineered for compute-intensive workloads that require both high per-core processor speed and sufficient memory density, ecs.hfg9i.8xlarge allocates dedicated physical compute cores to eliminate noisy-neighbor interference. Because local storage is absent, all persistent storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached block storage volumes. System administrators should also plan for remote routing or address allocation since the instance comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This instance profile offers cost efficiency for scenarios requiring sustained clock frequency without moving to specialized low-memory configurations. It is well matched for gaming servers, high-frequency batch processing, distributed application servers, continuous integration pipelines, and memory-conscious enterprise database nodes.
